status: exploratory; original historical outcomes have already been inspected
original_primary: Retain original result and sample; these new tests cannot overturn its status.

methods.bjzz_common: Original BJZZ signal on common valid-quote eligible prints; its signed print set differs from QMP
methods.qmp_weighted: Weight stock-day signed buy and sell volumes by 1-disagreements/both_signed; five days, no fitted parameter
methods.qmp_drop_worst: Remove the single stock-day with highest disagreement fraction; ties remove earliest day; retain four days
methods.qmp_random_drop: Remove one of five stock-days uniformly; deterministic seed; same four-day count, not equal retained volume
methods.proxy_blend: Equal mean of original QMP and BJZZ OIB; proxy combination, not independent-error correction

no_truth: Neither proxy is ground truth; disagreement is not a misclassification probability.
missing_disagreement: Both-signed count zero: fraction unavailable; retain as missing, no zero imputation.
signal_eligibility: All five daily records and fractions required; each variant >=20 retained unweighted signed prints and positive denominator. Complete formation/control intersection for all variants. Future-label missingness counted separately.
daily_level_limit: No jointly-signed buy/sell volume in cache. Exact agreement-only trade signal cannot be reconstructed; no trade-level filtering or true error correction claimed.
matched_control: 20 seeded uniform four-day deletion replications; average their per-week metrics, never average their signals for this comparison
outcomes: Original next-close entry, five-session week1 return; original non-overlapping windows and settlement rules inherited.
diagnostics: Raw Spearman IC, FWL control/industry-adjusted coefficient, agreement with QMP, mean retained share-volume fraction
forecasting: Expanding ridge; at least 52 matured windows; each training week weighted equally; fixed penalty 1; no tuning; all training exits <= current signal date; current features normalized using formation information only.
forecast_design: Intercept, SIC2 dummies for fixed codes 1..99, seven cross-section normalized controls, optionally one normalized OIB. Normalize/winsorize controls at formation 1/99 percentiles; OIB standardized, not winsorized. Only missing outcomes excluded from loss calculation.
primary_inference: 4 method-vs-QMP comparisons (BJZZ, weighted, drop-worst, blend) x 3 scopes x 2 metrics (IC and predictive MSE) =24 tests; Holm correction across all 24. 4000 circular 4-window block bootstrap paired CIs; HAC lag4 normal p values. Bootstrap conditional on fitted predictions, does not retrain models.
secondary_inference: drop-worst IC minus average random-deletion IC: 3 scopes, Holm3; 8-window bootstrap sensitivity for primary contrasts.

simulation.purpose: Verify exact conditional mean/variance under independent flips, Pearson attenuation approximation and empirical Spearman behavior; these are simulated assumptions.

bounded_sensitivity: Assume at most delta of signed SHARE VOLUME is wrongly signed, with fixed trade membership/denominator; |true OIB-observed OIB|<=2delta. delta=.01,.025,.05,.1,.2. Report robust signs and pairwise ordering; no claim these are estimated errors.
